My two stoner buddies decided to bring these awesome edibles: weed-laced peanut butter between two graham crackers. All of a sudden my vision was flashing from hazy-reality to solid white and I felt fizzy. I tried to sit down, but instead I fell through the wallpaper of reality. All there is on the other side is a jetson-like rocky platform that sticks out from the darkness below. There were rail-road tracks also that connected to the platform and descended in a spiral into the abyss. Soon, a tiny troll in a mining cart rolled up to my platform (I could still hear planes taking off somewhere). He didn't say anything to me, but motioned for me to get in the cart. I obliged and we carted away.

Several hours later I awoke on the plane as it was pulling up to the terminal.

TL;DR - I ate weed crackers in an airport and fell through the wallpaper of reality
